verdict.rationale: Cloud Identity docs include "Creating a dynamic group", so rule-based group membership exists, though only as a bare heading. Group-based assignment is shown only for security policies: 2SV methods can be enforced per group, and Context-Aware Access gates app access on attributes like user identity. No evidence shows apps being assigned or provisioned to groups instead of one user at a time. missing for 10: documentation of group-based app assignment (e.g., SAML/third-party app access by group), detail on dynamic-group membership rules and how they evaluate, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, access is assigned by group and rule — dynamic group membership and group-based app assignment replace one-by-one grants
